load_fasttext_model: load a binarized fastText model from a given file path
read_txt_embeddings: read pretrained word embeddings from a text file and return word-to-id mapping with torch tensor
load_bin_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a fastText binary file and return word-to-id mapping with torch tensor
load_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from either a text or fastText binary file based on extension
build_embeddings_from_fasttext: build pretrained embeddings by loading a fastText binary model and converting vectors to a torch tensor
